card.name: The x inside KRYSTEXXA and similar names
card.fires_on: The letters EX or ux right before a final x or xa inside a drug name, mainly KRYSTEXXA. Also seen in febuxostat and a few other names with x.

modes.label: KRYSTEXXA name
modes.description: The EX piece in the brand name KRYSTEXXA, just before the closing XA.
modes.example: Anaphylaxis : Anaphylaxis may occur with any KRYST<<EX>>XA infusion.

modes.label: Other x names
modes.description: An x-containing piece in another drug or name, such as febuxostat or an author initial.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward x-type endings like x, xx and xxx, and away from ordinary word endings.
card.plain: It fires partway through the drug name KRYSTEXXA, when the next letters are another x.
